rules.statement: The acquired property of a son who dies unmarried, childless, and intestate goes to the mother if she is alive; otherwise, it goes to the father.
rules.supporting_quote: "According to Armour's Kandyan Law, pp. 88, 89, the mother is heiress to the acquired property of all kinds left by a child who dies unmarried, childless, and intestate, and such property is entirely at her disposal, and if the mother had died previous to the demise of her child, then the father will be entitled to the reversion of the deceased child's acquired property."
